name: Xander
description: Vampire crime-lord and boss of the Maestros family in New Capenna, killed by Ob Nixilis.

description_citations.text: "Xander". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander measures Anhelo for a new outfit and shares worries about Halo supply.
timeline.quote: "The balance of power in this town is shifting."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander orders Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: gather the information on what this source is by whatever means necessary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander retreats to a hidden room of ancient texts on New Capenna's founding.
timeline.quote: Statues of winged angels were locked in stony prayer

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth works as a museum recruit, cataloguing artwork that hints at Phyrexians, and decides the curator Xander knows more.
timeline.quote: The leader of the Maestros wasn't collecting all these relics by chance.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that to learn more she must work for it, and she agrees to take jobs that make her a true member of the family.
timeline.quote: She met his eyes. "I'm ready."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that New Capenna was founded by a deal between archangels and demonlords against an unknown enemy, and that he is one of the original signers.
timeline.quote: "Yes, I am, indeed, one of those original signers and have willingly become part demon

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander gives Elspeth Halo to drink, describing it as the last gift of the angels.
timeline.quote: "Halo was the last gift of the angels."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
timeline.quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander names Elspeth an officer of the Maestros and gives her a knife; she demands full access to his archives in return for this last job.
timeline.quote: "Do this for me, and all the knowledge in my archives will be yours."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: On the eve of the Crescendo, Xander walks the museum one last time, names Anhelo his heir and orders him to go to the Crescendo in his place.
timeline.quote: "But someday soon, you will be."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander sends Anhelo out the receiving door, sensing enemies are close, and then confronts the Adversary in the shadows.
timeline.quote: "Have you finally come to kill me, Adversary?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander's former assassins turn on him in the museum and he kills several with his cane-blade before retreating.
timeline.quote: Xander grabbed it, slashing through the air and sending a spray of ash across the room.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander flees to the viewing deck and duels the Adversary, who lands behind him.
timeline.quote: "Did you really think you could escape me?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary blasts Xander with magic and Xander falls from Park Heights into the clouds below.
timeline.quote: His foot met open air, and he plummeted into the clouds below.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis revels over Xander's mutilated body, and a Maestro informs him that the Font escaped the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "The Font escaped."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis learns another unaccounted person aided the escape, realizes Xander played him, and vows to find the Font.
timeline.quote: Even from beyond the grave, Xander had played him.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo gives Elspeth and Vivien Xander's letter naming him successor and granting Elspeth access to the archives.
timeline.quote: The Maestros are now in your hands

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: A news crier announces that Lord Xander has been found dead.
timeline.quote: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

citation.text: Sky Crier (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth seeks answers while Xander needs a spy, and their paths cross.
timeline.quote: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy.

citation.text: An Offer You Can't Refuse (Streets of New Capenna, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo, killing Xander and mortally wounding Jetmir; Giada's sacrifice awakens the angels.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir mortally wounded.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis infiltrates the plane and strikes the families' leadership on the night of the Crescendo; Xander is killed and Jetmir wounded.
timeline.quote: At least one boss, Xander , was killed, with Jetmir seriously wounded.

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "The Adversary War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the night of the Cabaretti Crescendo, Ob Nixilis has his agents attack all five families of New Capenna and kills Xander himself.
timeline.quote: Nixilis himself traveled to the Maestro Museum, killing the family's leader, Xander , personally.

citation.text: "Ob Nixilis", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The archdemons betray the angels, turning their bodies into Halo, defeat the Phyrexians, and raise five individuals to demonic status over five factions.
timeline.quote: the archdemons proved their nature and captured the angels

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "Betrayal and the creation of Halo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander founds the Maestros and becomes New Capenna's first vampire, siring Evelyn and Anhelo.
timeline.quote: Xander, founder and head of the Maestros, was the first vampire, and his first progeny was Evelyn .

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Xander's death in the Cabaretti Crescendo, Anhelo is promoted.
timeline.quote: he was promoted after his boss's death during the Cabaretti Crescendo .

citation.text: "Anhelo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander, an ailing artist, accepts the archdemons' gift of eternal life and unwittingly becomes a vampire.
timeline.quote: He was offered the gift of eternal life from the plane's archdemons

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander becomes one of the five family heads and signatories of the contract that created New Capenna.
timeline.quote: He was one of the five heads of families that were appointed by the archdemons

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis kills Xander on New Year's night during the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: Xander was killed by Ob Nixilis

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xander wills control of the Maestros to his deputy Anhelo.
timeline.quote: He willed control of the Maestros to his deputy, Anhelo .

citation.text: "Xander", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: his loyal Deacon and right hand
relations.quote: All Xander required of his Deacon was loyalty.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

relations.note: carries out his jobs in exchange for information
relations.quote: "I held up my end of the bargain, now for yours."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

relations.note: Xander's general, and his intended successor.
relations.quote: Xander could feel his general's confusion as he followed Xander about the museum.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.note: Blasts Xander off the balcony and mutilates his body.
relations.quote: The mighty head of the Maestros, the infamous Xander, master assassin .

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.note: Took missions from Xander and was given his knife.
relations.quote: the knife Xander had given her

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.quote: He was Lord Xander's right-hand man before the city was built
